entry.postTitle: Talk instead — answer a few questions
entry.postBody: I ask, you answer out loud. Hindi, Telugu or English.
entry.profileBody: Answer a few questions out loud. You check everything before it's saved.

intro.title: Answer a few questions
intro.body: I'll ask one question at a time, out loud, in {{language}}. Answer in your own words — I'll wait for you.
intro.micNote: Your browser will ask to use the microphone. Allow it so I can hear you.
intro.nothingPosted: Nothing is posted or saved until you check it.
intro.waitingForMic: Allow the microphone in the box your browser is showing — or answer by typing.

kind.question: What do you need — someone for a job, a project done, or a local service?
kind.hint: Say job, project or local service
kind.again: Please say job, project or local service, or tap one below.

mic.waiting: Tap the mic when you're ready

talk.noVoice: This device can't speak {{language}}, so the questions are shown here as text. You can still answer out loud.
talk.tapWhenReady: Tap the mic when you're ready.
talk.summarySpoken: That's everything. Please check your answers.
talk.networkTrouble: I couldn't check that answer just now. Tap the mic and say it again, or type it.
talk.sayYesOrNo: Please say yes or no, or tap a button.
talk.needed: I need this one to post.
talk.didntCatch: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please say it once more.
talk.errorBody: Check your internet connection and try again. Your answers so far are kept.
talk.listeningConfirm: Say yes, or say the right answer.

typingReason.unsupported: This browser can't listen, so you'll answer by typing — still one question at a time.
typingReason.blocked: The microphone is blocked, so you can answer by typing. To talk, allow the microphone in your browser settings.
typingReason.nomic: No microphone was found, so you can answer by typing.
typingReason.network: Voice needs an internet connection. You can answer by typing.

summary.title: Here's what I have
summary.nothingPosted: Nothing is posted yet. Next you'll see everything in full and can change any detail.
summary.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved yet. Next you'll see your profile in full and can change any detail.

form.filled: Filled in from what you said. Check it and change anything that isn't right.
